summary: A top-level seat's ask survives its restarts and harness changes and ends only when the seat stops or retires or the requester cancels it; an ask cancelled because its owner ended tells the requester once and leaves the person one update (#2092)

replay.detail: No replay. Asks are re-evaluated on read and by the existing person-ask reconcile pass.

schema.detail: No database or client schema change.

rules.detail: Ask liveness: a --new-run ask from a top-level seat is no longer fenced on the seat's exact declaration claim, only on stop or retirement; mission seats keep the declaration fence. Mixed builds can disagree about such an ask after a seat is re-declared until every member runs this build: an older member cancels it, which then replicates.

compatibility.detail: New --new-run asks from a top-level seat derive their subject without the declaration claim, so asking again with the same idempotency key after a re-declaration returns the same ask. The daemon now writes one message.sent from daemon/runtime to the requester and one person update when it cancels an ask whose owner ended.

manual.detail: No manual action is required. Asks already cancelled before this build stay cancelled.

recovery.detail: Swap back freely; an older build cancels re-declared seats' asks again on its next reconcile pass.
